questions.solution:

• **Example: **She answered all the questions correctly.

• **Example:** He was totally unaware of the upcoming surprise.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The shareholders will elect him director.

options.text: He will be elected director by the shareholders.
The shareholders have elected him a director.
The shareholders elected him a director.
He will be elected a director.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the active voice:** "The shareholders will elect him director."**
 
• In the passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the **passive sentence.**
 
• The correct passive construction is:** "He will be elected director by the shareholders."**
 
• Thus, the correct transformation of the given sentence into passive voice is **option 1.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**He will be elected director by the shareholders."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The shareholders have elected him a director." – This is in the present perfect tense, not the passive voice.
 
• **Option 3:** "The shareholders elected him a director." – This is in the simple past tense, not the passive voice.
 
• **Option 4:** "He will be elected a director." – This is passive but lacks the agent "by the shareholders."

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It is also called a nuclear family.

B. It is good to be in a small family because there is better management of resources.

C. A small family is one with parents and a maximum of two children.

D. The advantages of a small family are numerous.

The correct answer is **Option 1.**

• To form a coherent paragraph, we need to arrange the sentences logically to provide a clear flow of information.
 
• **Sentence C is the first sentence** as it defines what a small family is:
 
 
• "A small family is one with parents and a maximum of two children."
